sentences.text: The genus Mitsuokella is placed in the family Selenomonadaceae.
An analysis of published human gut taxonomic profiles reported that Mitsuokella species, in particular M. jalaludinii, are prevalent in human gut microbiomes.
The same study identified Mitsuokella jalaludinii as an efficient phytate degrader that works synergistically with Anaerostipes rhamnosivorans to produce the short-chain fatty acid propionate.
A screening study reported that Mitsuokella jalaludinii gave the most pronounced in vitro uric acid reduction among tested strains, lowering uric acid by about 30 percent after 48 hours.
